top_stories.title: GPS jammed on RAF jet carrying UK defence secretary close to Russian border | Russia | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: **John Healey**, the UK defence secretary, experienced a three-hour GPS signal jam on his flight back to the UK from Estonia. The incident occurred while the **RAF** jet was near the Russian border and is suspected to have been orchestrated by **Russia**.  The disruption affected internet connectivity and navigation systems for passengers, including photographers and a reporter. This follows a pattern of aggressive Russian actions against British aircraft in recent months, including an incident where a **Russian Su-35** jet flew dangerously close to a **Rivet Joint** spy plane last month.

top_stories.title: Man held on charge of theft - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Rajan alias Natarajan**, a 61-year-old Tamil Nadu native, has been arrested in connection with the theft of 45 sovereigns of gold ornaments from a house in Bekal.  The **Bekal police** recovered the stolen jewelry from a hideout on Netaji Road near Kannur railway station following a complaint filed by the homeowner.

top_stories.title: After San Diego shooting, Muslim Americans aim to turn grief into action | Islamophobia News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Muslim Americans** gathered at the annual ICNA conference in Baltimore, where they addressed the recent shooting at the Islamic Center of San Diego, which killed three people. Speakers emphasized the need for action and urged community members to engage in activism, voting, organizing, and donating to support their institutions and candidates who align with their values. They also condemned Islamophobia and called for an end to Israel's atrocities in Palestine.  The conference highlighted the ongoing struggle against anti-Muslim bigotry and the importance of defending civil liberties.

top_stories.title: Cuba thanks China for rice shipment amid worsening humanitarian conditions | Government News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Cuba** has received its first shipment of 15,000 tonnes of rice from **China**, a donation that comes amidst worsening humanitarian conditions caused by a fuel blockade imposed by the **United States**.  Cuban President **Miguel Diaz-Canel** expressed gratitude to **China** and members of the European Parliament for their support. The **Trump administration** has intensified sanctions against Cuba, seeking regime change and threatening military intervention, while also accusing the Cuban government of economic mismanagement and human rights violations.

top_stories.title: ‘He was never violent’: White House shooter Nasire Best’s mother breaks silence after seeing son’s death on social media - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Nasire Best**, a 21-year-old man, was fatally shot by **Secret Service** officers near the White House after allegedly opening fire.  Best had previous encounters with law enforcement near the White House and a documented history of mental health problems. A bystander was also injured during the exchange of gunfire. The shooting caused panic around the White House complex, prompting reporters to take cover as they witnessed the incident unfold. **President Donald Trump** praised the officers involved in the response.

top_stories.title: Ecuador’s Noboa pledges to extradite criminals in State of the Union speech | Crime News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Daniel Noboa**, Ecuador's president, addressed the National Assembly in his State of the Union speech, highlighting crime-fighting strategies and economic progress. He emphasized the extradition of a dozen criminals to the US and the seizure of drugs as evidence of his effectiveness.  However, critics argue that his iron-fisted methods have failed to reduce crime and put civilians at risk. **Glaedys Gonzalez**, an analyst for the Andean region at the International Crisis Group, stated that progress on violence is far from being achieved.

top_stories.title: KTR accuses Congress govt. of conspiring to install meters to farm power connections - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **K.T. Rama Rao**, working president of the **Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS)**, accused the **Congress government** in Telangana of planning to privatize the energy sector by installing prepaid meters for domestic consumers. He alleged that the decision was part of a larger scheme to hand over distribution businesses to corporate companies like **Adani Group**, and would result in consumers paying for electricity in advance.  Rao criticized the Congress's handling of power supply, accusing them of corruption and failing to fulfill promises made to the public.

top_stories.title: Pregnant woman murdered over ‘Atla Taddi’ dispute; husband, father-in-law arrested - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Meghana**, a pregnant woman, was found dead on February 9th in Eluru district. Her husband, **N. Pradeep**, allegedly smothered her to death with a pillow and attempted to conceal the cause of death as cardiac arrest.  Police arrested **Pradeep** and his father, **Narasimha Rao**, after forensic evidence confirmed asphyxiation. The couple is currently in judicial custody.

top_stories.title: Elderly woman allegedly robbed of gold worth ₹11.6 lakh in Muvattupuzha - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Muvattupuzha police** are investigating a robbery case where an elderly woman, **Mariyamma Paily**, was allegedly robbed of gold ornaments worth approximately ₹11.6 lakh. The incident occurred on Sunday (May 24, 2026) at her residence when an unidentified suspect entered her bedroom, locked her domestic help in the bathroom, and stole the jewelry she was wearing.  The case has been registered under charges including wrongful confinement, house-trespass, and robbery under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.

top_stories.title: Marco Rubio in India LIVE: Jaishankar addresses National Day reception at the U.S. Embassy - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio** stated that bilateral relations between **India** and the **United States** remain strong, with hopes for a soon-to-be-sealed trade deal.  During his visit to India, **Mr. Rubio** met with **Minister of External Affairs S. Jaishankar**, describing his experience as "fantastic." This visit comes amidst economic and diplomatic tensions between the two nations stemming from U.S. tariffs on Indian exports imposed by former President Donald Trump.
